verdict.rationale: Gusto now offers business formation and entity compliance services, so asking whether it can prepare board consents and collect approvals online is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence covers only LLC/company formation, EIN registration, state tax registration, annual reports, registered agent and mail monitoring. None of it documents drafting board consents or resolutions or collecting director approvals online. Those compliance filings are adjacent features and earn no credit toward this story.
